findings.evidenceJa: 悪いコトはもう起きない
findings.governingReading: Sakura insists that nothing bad will happen anymore.

findings.highlight: I'm certainly in favor of this newfound weight loss.
findings.evidenceJa: 大繁盛、じゃなくて大賛成
findings.governingReading: She welcomes being lighter with an anxious malapropism, 大繁盛, then repairs it to 大賛成.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s accidental “great business” before correcting herself to “full support” disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 空気がこんなにも美味しい
findings.governingReading: Sakura experiences the air as 美味しい, an embodied taste or savor within the sensory sequence.
findings.explanation: Fresh air that tastes delicious becomes air that is visually beautiful.

findings.highlight: I saw someone at the end.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後に見たあの人の姿
findings.governingReading: She remembers his destroyed body and understands that she herself will never see him again.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s last image of Shirou and her certainty she can never meet him again become seeing “someone,” followed by “they” never meeting.

findings.highlight: I knew as soon I woke up
findings.evidenceJa: 目が覚めた時から判っていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura admits she understood from the moment she woke.
findings.explanation: The sentence omits the second “as” from “as soon as.”

findings.highlight: you can't ask me for help.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の方からお願いしなくちゃダメだ
findings.governingReading: Because he will impose on Sakura, he restarts and properly makes the request himself.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s insistence that he must be the one to ask Sakura for help becomes “you can’t ask me for help.”

findings.highlight: the boy muttered it to hide his embarrassment
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しに咳払いをする少年
findings.governingReading: Sakura sees him cough theatrically as a cover for embarrassment.
findings.explanation: Shirou clearing his throat to hide embarrassment becomes muttering the request.

findings.governingReading: With spring, Rin regains energy and acts vigorously to settle the aftermath.
findings.explanation: Rin moving energetically after recovering becomes “working her brain.”

findings.highlight: what will happen if she comes home.
findings.evidenceJa: 姉さんが帰ってしまったらどうなるか
findings.governingReading: Even today Sakura doubts she can endure being alone after her sister leaves.
findings.explanation: Sakura fears what will happen when Rin goes home; the English says when Rin comes home.

findings.governingReading: Sakura asks Fujimura-sensei’s father to arrange transfer of the land rights.

findings.highlight: I've been growing one flower every year
findings.evidenceJa: 年に一つずつ、花を育てる事にする
findings.governingReading: Unable to define atonement, she now resolves to grow one flower each year for the promised day.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s decision to begin growing one flower per year becomes an already ongoing habit.

findings.highlight: I'll protect you from everything people will ask you.
findings.evidenceJa: これから桜に問われる全てのコトから桜を守る
findings.governingReading: He vows to shield her from every accusation, judgment, or consequence that will confront her.
findings.explanation: Shirou protecting Sakura from everything she will be called to account for becomes protecting her from things people will “ask” her.

findings.highlight: make him go through the trouble I had to many times over.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの何倍も困らせてやる
findings.governingReading: She promises selfish demands and disproportionately much trouble in affectionate retaliation.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s vow to trouble Shirou many times more than he troubled her becomes malformed English.

findings.highlight: I'm not sad because something is absolute.
findings.evidenceJa: 悲しくないのは、絶対があるから
findings.governingReading: She is not sad because she has an absolute certainty: in proportion to the pain, she believes the promised outcome will surely be fulfilled.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s fixed certainty that the promise will be fulfilled becomes an undefined “something” that will compensate for suffering.
